name: FileExplorer
description:
1. Goal: add a **Go to folder** action to the file explorer's context menu so users can jump the tree to the parent folder of a selected entry.
2. `src/components/filebrowser/ContextMenu.vue` gained a new item (placed after **Move to…**), shown only when a selection exists, emitting a `go-to-folder` event.
3. `src/components/filebrowser/FileExplorer.vue` binds `@go-to-folder="handleContextGoToFolder"`, which resolves the parent directory of the first selected entry and reloads the tree there.
4. A root-safe helper `parentFolderPath()` clamps any resolved path to the project `basePath`, preventing navigation above the project root.
5. After loading, the originating entry is re-selected in the new listing so the landing point is obvious — most valuable when coming from search results.

messages.content: Add "go to folder" on context menu to switch tree explorer path to the parent folder containing the entry

Summary of changes: | File | Change | |---|---| | `src/components/filebrowser/ContextMenu.vue` | New **Go to folder** action in the selection group, emits `go-to-folder` | | `src/components/filebrowser/FileExplorer.vue` | Listens to `go-to-folder`, resolves the parent directory of the selected entry and loads it (generic `parentFolderPath` helper, root-safe) | Behaviour notes: - **Where it appears:** in the selection group of the context menu, right after **Move to…**, only when something is selected (hidden on blank-area right clicks, where "copy path" already targets the current folder). - **What it does:** `handleContextGoToFolder` resolves `parentFolderPath(entryPath(firstSelected))`, loads that directory and re-selects the entry if it is present, so the user immediately sees where the file lives (especially useful from search results where the row shows a relative path). - **Safety:** `parentFolderPath` clamps to `basePath`, so a path outside the project root can never be opened. Multi-selection navigates to the folder of the first item.
